capabilities: display parent nodes of the current canvas in a sidebar
navigate to a parent node by clicking its title
configure the length of node titles shown in the sidebar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is minimal and points to a video demo that is not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no built-in way to see which nodes are parents of the node you are viewing or jump to them.
summary: Canvas helper that lists all parent nodes of the current canvas view in a sidebar and navigates to them on click.
